slides.title: Case Study: Dutch Screening Laboratory Breach
slides.decision: Adopt supplier assurance that combines security evidence with tested substitution capacity.
slides.visual_type: Five-step timeline; capacity and notification charts; mechanism and outcome column

elements.visible_text: A July 2025 data breach at one outsourced laboratory became an in-period capacity problem: the Dutch national cervical screening programme halved primary invitations five months later.
parts: A July 2025 data breach at one outsourced laboratory became an in-period capacity problem: the Dutch national cervical screening programme halved primary invitations five months later.

elements.visible_text: July 2025 Laboratory hacked; programme operator informed more than a month later
parts: Laboratory hacked; programme operator informed more than a month later

elements.visible_text: August 2025 Laboratory suspended; 941,000 participants to be written to
parts: Laboratory suspended; 941,000 participants to be written to

elements.visible_text: From August 2025 Two backup laboratories run at about 150% of capacity for six months
parts: Two backup laboratories run at about 150% of capacity for six months

elements.visible_text: 22 December 2025 Primary invitations cut by 50%; follow-up tests continue in full
parts: Primary invitations cut by 50%; follow-up tests continue in full

elements.visible_text: 13 May 2026 Inspectorate finds the laboratory below the Dutch NEN 7510 health information-security norm
parts: Inspectorate finds the laboratory below the Dutch NEN 7510 health information-security norm

parts: load on the two backup laboratories, % of their regular capacity, for about six months from August 2025

Backup laboratories ran at about 150% from August; by December the backlog forced primary invitations to be halved, while follow-up tests continued in full.

parts: Thousands; green bars people identified as affected, grey bar the notification population

parts: About 405,000 were notified within weeks; the operator then wrote to all 941,000 participants whose data had been shared since 2017.

parts: Regulatory: inspectorate finding; data-protection investigation pending. Financial: no cost disclosed. Recovery depended on re-establishing trust in the supplier.
